verdict.rationale: Kitty's first-party docs cover each element of the story: changing kitty colors, using your own themes, and changing the theme non-interactively. A dedicated section covers changing color themes automatically when the OS switches between light and dark, and wide-gamut color formats are also supported. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of theming and auto light/dark switching, and evidence beyond section titles on how deep the theme library and switching configuration go.
